papers.title: RevolIACT: a longitudinally distributed array of compact AI-driven Cherenkov telescopes for the time-domain sub-TeV sky
papers.comment: 23 pages, 6 figures, 6 tables. Submitted for publication. Companion paper: E. Jobst et al., "A transformer analysis lowers the energy threshold and improves the sensitivity of a compact imaging atmospheric Cherenkov telescope", Submitted for publication
papers.summary: A longitudinally distributed array of compact AI-driven Cherenkov stations is assessed for sub-TeV transient coverage, relying on video-transformer analysis to reach required sensitivity.

papers.title: A transformer analysis lowers the energy threshold and improves the sensitivity of a compact imaging atmospheric Cherenkov telescope
papers.comment: 12 pages, 6 figures, 3 tables. Submitted for publication
papers.summary: Video vision transformer analysis of raw Cherenkov waveforms lowers the energy threshold and improves sensitivity of a compact 5 m telescope versus standard analysis.

papers.title: Search for UHE photon sources using direction-time clustering algorithms with a BDT particle discriminant
papers.comment: 8 pages, 5 figures, presented at the 29th European Cosmic Ray Symposium (ECRS2026)
papers.summary: Direction-time clustering with a boosted decision tree photon discriminant improves ultra-high-energy photon-flare searches and reduces the number of events needed.

papers.title: The Role of Galactic Shear in Regulating Local Star Formation Efficiency: A Combined MaNGA DynPop and ALMaQUEST Study
papers.comment: 23 pages, 6+2 figures, 1 table. Accepted for publication in ApJ
papers.summary: Random forest regression on MaNGA and ALMaQUEST data identifies galactic shear as the dynamical property most associated with lower local star formation efficiency.
